kaps_punt: Onderwerp 3 (Visuele geletterdheid), Kwartaal 4: waarneming van visuele stimuli in foto's en werklike voorwerpe om die kunselemente en ontwerpbeginsels in afbeeldings van geboue en argitektuur te identifiseer en te benoem.

items.bewering: Hierdie kwartaal kyk jy na geboue soos 'n kunstenaar na 'n prent kyk. Jy kyk na foto's van geboue en na regte geboue om jou.
items.bron: DBE CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6 (Intermediate Phase, English), Gr 6 Term 4 Visual literacy, printed p. 50: 'Observe visual stimuli in photographs and real objects to identify and name relevant art elements found in images of buildings and architecture'. The comparison to how an artist looks at a picture matches that task; nothing in it misleads. https://www.education.gov.za/Curriculum/CurriculumAssessmentPolicyStatements(CAPS)/CAPSIntermediate/tabid/572/Default.aspx

items.bewering: Die voorbeelde kom veral uit Suid-Afrika.
items.bron: True of the lesson itself: every example (rondawel, Cape Dutch house, Ndebele house) is South African. It also matches CAPS Gr 6 Visual literacy overview, printed p. 14: 'Introduce national environment'.

items.bewering: Die kuns en die werk om geboue te ontwerp, noem ons argitektuur.
items.bron: Britannica, 'Architecture': 'the art and technique of designing and building'. The lesson's wording is a fair simplification. https://www.britannica.com/topic/architecture

items.bewering: Op sommige plekke in KwaZulu-Natal en die Oos-Kaap staan rondawels.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rondavel' and Britannica 'Rondavel' (traditional Southern African dwelling); The Conversation, 'South Africa's modern rondavels', on rondavels in the Eastern Cape (Mbhashe). The lesson's 'op sommige plekke' is appropriately careful. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rondavel ; https://www.britannica.com/technology/rondavel ; https://theconversation.com/south-africas-modern-rondavels-family-homes-may-be-changing-but-traditions-remain-242247

items.bewering: 'n Rondawel is 'n ronde huis met 'n dak wat dikwels soos 'n keël lyk.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rondavel': round, with a cylindrical single cell and a conical thatched roof; usually round or oval. 'dikwels' is appropriately careful. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rondavel

items.bewering: In dele van die Wes-Kaap sien jy Kaaps-Hollandse huise.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Cape Dutch architecture' (a vernacular style of the Cape Colony); SA Tourism (southafrica.net) and sa-venues: common throughout the Cape, especially the Winelands (Stellenbosch, Franschhoek). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cape_Dutch_architecture ; https://www.southafrica.net/gl/en/travel/article/cape-dutch-architecture

items.bewering: Baie van hulle het wit mure, 'n grasdak en 'n versierde gewel bo die voordeur.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Cape Dutch architecture': whitewashed walls, thatched roofs, decorative gables; a tall gable above the front door. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cape_Dutch_architecture

items.bewering: Sommige Ndebele-vroue in Suid-Afrika verf die mure van hul huise. Die mure kry hoekige patrone in helder kleure.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Ndebele house painting': painted by women; geometric patterns (diamonds, triangles, zigzags) in bold colours since acrylic paints arrived in the 1940s. 'Sommige' is appropriately careful. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ndebele_house_painting

items.bewering: Jy sien sulke huise byvoorbeeld in dele van Mpumalanga.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Ndebele house painting': the painted homes of the Southern Ndebele are chiefly in Mpumalanga and Gauteng. 'byvoorbeeld' correctly leaves room for other areas. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ndebele_house_painting

items.bewering: Die reguit rande van 'n dak en die regop pilare van 'n stoep is lyne. Vensters is dikwels reghoeke, en die punt van 'n dak kan 'n driehoek wees. 'n Ronde venster of 'n boog oor 'n deur gee 'n geboë vorm.
items.bron: Line and shape as art elements: CAPS Gr 4-6 overview, printed p. 14 ('art elements, such as line, shape...'). Wikipedia 'Gable': the gable is the triangular part of the wall under the roof pitches. The observations themselves are plain and correctly hedged ('dikwels', 'kan'). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gable

items.bewering: Jy sien kleur in die verf van mure en deure. 'n Grasdak lyk grof, 'n baksteenmuur lyk ru en glas lyk glad. Dit is tekstuur.
items.bron: Texture as actual and implied texture: artsology.com 'Two Types of Texture in Art: Actual vs. Implied'; CAPS names texture as an art element (printed p. 14). Describing how the surfaces look fits implied texture. https://artsology.com/blog/2025/09/texture-in-art/

items.bewering: Ruimte is die oop plek rondom en tussen die geboue.
items.bron: Space is one of the standard art elements (line, shape, form, space, colour, value, texture). CAPS Gr 6 uses space, including deep and shallow space (printed p. 14, 50). Space as the open area around and between things is standard (Kennedy Center, 'Formal Visual Analysis'). https://www.kennedy-center.org/education/resources-for-educators/classroom-resources/articles-and-how-tos/articles/educators/visual-arts/formal-visual-analysis-the-elements-and-principles-of-compositoin/

items.bewering: Drie ontwerpbeginsels ken jy al uit vorige jare. (kontras, verhouding en klem)
items.bron: CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6, overview p. 14 and term plans p. 45-48: Grade 4 teaches 'formal teaching of contrast and proportion'; Grade 5 'Introduce emphasis' (Term 1, 'emphasis (focal point)'). So all three come from earlier grades.

items.bewering: Baie Kaaps-Hollandse huise se wit mure vorm 'n kontras met die donkerder grasdak.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Cape Dutch architecture': whitewashed walls with dark grey thatch. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cape_Dutch_architecture

items.bewering: By verhouding vergelyk jy hoe groot die voordeur is met die hele voorkant van dieselfde gebou.
items.bron: Proportion as the size relationship between parts and the whole: Art for Life, 'The Principles of Art'; CAPS Gr 4 Term 2, printed p. 45: 'introduce proportion, e.g. the size of one form in relation to another'. https://www.artforlife.uk/art/the-principles-of-art

items.bewering: By so 'n huis trek die versierde gewel dikwels die oog eerste. Die gewel is dan die fokuspunt, en die klem val daarop.
items.bron: 'eerste' here means the first thing the eye goes to, not a historical superlative, and 'dikwels' hedges it. Wikipedia 'Cape Dutch architecture' calls the front gable the distinctive, ornate feature of the style. CAPS Gr 5 Term 1, printed p. 47, equates emphasis with focal point ('emphasis (focal point)'). https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cape_Dutch_architecture

items.bewering: Balans het jy eers vanjaar in die eerste kwartaal leer ken.
items.blok: Balans in die voorkant van 'n gebou
items.bron: CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6, Gr 6 Term 1, printed p. 49: Visual literacy 'identify and name balance'; Create in 3D 'Design principles: introduce balance'. The overview (p. 14) says Grade 6 is where the conscious use of balance is introduced. Balance does not appear as a design principle in Grade 4 or 5.

items.bewering: By baie geboue lyk die twee kante van daardie lyn byna dieselfde. So 'n huis het byvoorbeeld 'n venster aan elke kant van die voordeur. Dit is simmetriese balans.
items.blok: Balans in die voorkant van 'n gebou
items.bron: Symmetrical balance as mirror-image halves about a central axis: Smashing Magazine, 'Design Principles: Compositional, Symmetrical And Asymmetrical Balance'. The example matches the Cape Dutch facade, which has evenly spaced windows on either side of the door (Wikipedia 'Cape Dutch architecture'). https://www.smashingmagazine.com/2015/06/design-principles-compositional-balance-symmetry-asymmetry/

items.bewering: Ander geboue het asimmetriese balans, en die twee kante lyk verskillend maar ewe swaar. 'n Gebou hoef nie simmetries te wees nie.
items.blok: Balans in die voorkant van 'n gebou
items.bron: Smashing Magazine (as above) and HubSpot, 'Asymmetrical vs. Symmetrical Balance': the two sides differ but carry equal visual weight, so the composition still looks balanced. https://blog.hubspot.com/marketing/asymmetrical-balance

items.bewering: Eenheid is nog 'n nuwe ontwerpbeginsel van Graad 6.
items.bron: CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6 overview, printed p. 14: the Grade 6 Visual literacy column names 'contrast, proportion, emphasis, balance and unity'. Unity appears in neither the Grade 4 nor the Grade 5 column, nor in any Grade 4 or 5 term plan (p. 45-48). 'nog 'n nuwe' correctly pairs it with balance.

items.bewering: Vensters van dieselfde vorm wat in rye herhaal, kan 'n gebou een geheel laat lyk. Dieselfde baksteen, dieselfde kleur of 'n patroon oor al die mure kan dit ook doen. Eenheid laat al die dele van 'n ontwerp lyk asof hulle bymekaar hoort.
items.bron: LibreTexts 'Principles of Design: Unity and Variety' and Venngage 'Unity in Design': elements appear to belong together as a whole, achieved through repetition of shape, colour and material. The mixed-windows counter-example fits that definition. https://human.libretexts.org/Courses/Prince_Georges_Community_College/Introduction_to_Art_and_Art_History_Part_I/03:_Foundation-_Principles_of_Design/3.02:_Principles_of_Design-_Unity_and_Variety

items.bewering: Hierdie manier van kyk sluit die jaar af.
items.bron: CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6, Gr 6 Term 4 (the last term), printed p. 50: Visual literacy on buildings and architecture.

items.bewering: Let laastens op waarheen jou oog eerste gaan, want daar is die fokuspunt.
items.bron: 'eerste' is not a historical superlative here. A focal point is the place the eye is drawn to first (Kennedy Center 'Formal Visual Analysis'; CAPS Gr 5 'emphasis (focal point)', printed p. 47).

items.bewering: argitektuur: Die kuns en die werk om geboue te ontwerp.
items.bron: Britannica, 'Architecture': 'the art and technique of designing and building'. https://www.britannica.com/topic/architecture

items.bewering: eenheid: 'n Ontwerpbeginsel wat al die dele van 'n ontwerp laat lyk asof hulle bymekaar hoort.
items.bron: Venngage and LibreTexts (as above): unity arranges elements so they appear to belong together as a cohesive whole. Read alone, the entry does not fit any other principle. https://venngage.com/blog/design-principle-unity/

items.bewering: rondawel: 'n Ronde huis, dikwels met 'n dak wat soos 'n keël lyk.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Rondavel'; Britannica 'Rondavel'. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rondavel

items.bewering: gewel: Die boonste deel van 'n muur wat tot by die punt van 'n dak opstaan, soos aan die kant van 'n huis of bo 'n voordeur, en wat soms versier is.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Gable': the generally triangular portion of a wall between the edges of intersecting roof pitches. Cape Dutch houses also have a front gable over the door (Wikipedia 'Cape Dutch architecture'). The entry covers both, and a Cape Dutch gable that rises above the roofline still reaches its apex. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gable

items.bewering: kontras: 'n Duidelike verskil tussen twee dinge wat langs mekaar staan.
items.bron: Contrast as the juxtaposition of different elements that highlights their differences: Art for Life, 'The Principles of Art'; Kennedy Center 'Formal Visual Analysis'. https://www.artforlife.uk/art/the-principles-of-art

items.bewering: verhouding: Hoe groot een deel van 'n ding is in vergelyking met die res daarvan.
items.bron: Proportion as the size relationship of parts to the whole and to each other (Art for Life, 'The Principles of Art'); CAPS Gr 4, printed p. 45: 'the size of one form in relation to another'. Comparing one part with 'the rest' is accurate and fits the lesson's door-to-facade example. https://www.artforlife.uk/art/the-principles-of-art

items.bewering: klem: 'n Ontwerpbeginsel wat een deel van 'n prent laat uitstaan en die oog daarheen trek.
items.bron: Emphasis gives special attention to one part of a work of art (Art for Life, 'The Principles of Art'); CAPS Gr 5 'emphasis (focal point)', printed p. 47.

items.bewering: fokuspunt: Die plek in 'n prent wat die oog eerste na hom toe trek.
items.bron: Kennedy Center, 'Formal Visual Analysis': the focal point is the area the viewer's eye is drawn to first. CAPS Gr 5 pairs emphasis with focal point (printed p. 47).

items.bewering: tekstuur: Hoe 'n oppervlak voel as jy dit aanraak, of hoe dit lyk asof dit sou voel.
items.bron: artsology.com, 'Two Types of Texture in Art: Actual vs. Implied': real texture can be felt, and implied texture only looks as if it would feel a certain way. The entry covers both halves. https://artsology.com/blog/2025/09/texture-in-art/

items.bewering: ruimte: Die plek rondom, tussen en binne-in die dinge in 'n kunswerk.
items.bron: Space as the area around, between and within objects (positive and negative space): Kennedy Center, 'Formal Visual Analysis'; CAPS Gr 6 deep and shallow space, printed p. 14 and 50.

items.bewering: simmetriese balans: Balans waar die twee helftes van 'n prent dieselfde of byna dieselfde lyk.
items.bron: Smashing Magazine, 'Design Principles: Compositional, Symmetrical And Asymmetrical Balance': symmetrical balance mirrors the halves about an axis. Near-symmetry is also standardly counted as symmetrical balance, so 'byna dieselfde' is accurate. https://www.smashingmagazine.com/2015/06/design-principles-compositional-balance-symmetry-asymmetry/

items.bewering: asimmetriese balans: Balans waar die twee kante van 'n prent verskillend lyk, maar tog ewe swaar lyk.
items.bron: HubSpot, 'Asymmetrical vs. Symmetrical Balance': the two sides look different yet the composition still seems balanced through equal visual weight. https://blog.hubspot.com/marketing/asymmetrical-balance

opsomming: All 35 claims in this full, fresh check are confirmed, including the three South African building types, the order in which CAPS teaches the design principles (checked against the DBE's own curriculum document), and every glossary definition, and no textbook was opened.
